generator: the AlgoLift app, scripts/indicators/classics/fixtures.mts (the strategy node's formula)
note: The AlgoLift strategy node's own formula on the cases TA-Lib was compared on (talib/kama.json, KAMA). It differs from TA-Lib by a convention, so these numbers are its own: Starts from the average of the period values before its first bar; TA-Lib's KAMA starts from the one value just before it. The values differ at the start and the difference shrinks every bar as the average forgets its start (on the fixture's bars it is gone by bar 340 at the default period). The fast and slow constants are settings, fast_period and slow_period (TA-Lib fixes them at 2 and 30, these defaults). Defaults to a period of 10 (TA-Lib: 30). Adds slope, and efficiency_ratio (the window's net move over its total travel), which TA-Lib does not output.
